sections.name: 文型
sections.purpose: This section provides examples of identifying and modifying nouns with これ, それ, and この.
sections.instructions: Read each of the three sentences aloud. Note that furigana is provided for the kanji characters. Compare your understanding with the answers provided in the grammar book, page 18. Feel free to repeat the sentences as many times as you need to understand them and pronounce them correctly.

sections.name: 例文
sections.purpose: This exercise is meant to be done in pairs, with one person reading the top sentences and the other reading the bottom sentences. If you don't have a partner, you can read the sentences to yourself. It is a series of questions about items near the speaker and listener.
sections.instructions: Either with a partner or by yourself, read the sentences aloud. If you have a partner, switch roles after each sentence. If you don't have a partner, read the sentences to yourself. Note that words in square brackets are optional. Feel free to repeat the sentences as many times as you need to understand them and pronounce them correctly.

sections.name: 会話：これからお世話になります。
sections.purpose: Listen to introductions between Yamada Ichiro and Jose Santos.
sections.instructions: Listen to the audio while reading the sentences. If needed, use the slow playback button as they speak fairly rapidly. Finally, listen to the audio without reading the sentences to see if you can understand it. You can also attempt to shadow the speakers, speaking along with them. Use the grammar book, page 18, to check your understanding of the sentences.

sections.name: 練習A
sections.purpose: Combine various vocabulary to practice identifying objects near the speaker and listener, ask clarifying questions, and modify nouns with possession.
sections.instructions: For each number, the tan boxes feature interchangeable nouns, with the white sections being fixed parts of the sentences. For example, the first sentence might introduce yourself either as Mike Miller or as a company employee. Try various combinations to practice the sentences for five minutes.

sections.name: 練習C
sections.purpose: Follow along with the conversation, replacing the example nouns with the ones in the pictures.
sections.instructions: With a partner or by yourself, read the conversations aloud. First read them with the underlined nouns, then read them with the nouns in the pictures. For reference, they appear to be, in order, chocolates, a ballpoint pen, a business card from a hospital, a car key, a notebook, and a pencil. Feel free to repeat the sentences as many times as you need to understand them and pronounce them correctly.
